what: Gain of microphone input 1 of an RME Babyface Pro FS in class-compliant mode for every value from 0 to 65 dB, measured on 18 November 2026.
method: A sine at half of full scale left the unit on XLR output 1 and came back over a cable on XLR input 1; a test app on the iPad read the level at the frequency of the tone on input channel 1, the median of three stretches of 0.15 s. Gain 0 to 45 dB was read with the output at raw 123, gain 20 to 65 dB with the output at raw 83, so that the input stayed more than 10 dB under full scale; the two parts overlap from 20 to 45 dB, and the upper part is shifted by their mean difference there (20.565 dB measured; the level law of the output gives 20.561 dB). db is the level relative to gain 0. Pad off, no phantom power. No other audio app was open; the iPad reported 44,100 Hz.
